usages.explain: Describes the situation where the speaker accomplishes their desires after much effort, difficulty, or time. Often used in the form「やっとV-た」, it conveys the speaker's feelings of relief or joy, or the sense of "finally after much time" or "after much hardship".

examples.mean: I finally put out the fire.

examples.content: 仕事は半分終わった、やっと休憩できる。
examples.transcription: しごとははんぶんおわった、やっときゅうけいできる。
examples.mean: I've done half the work, and now I can take a break.

examples.content: 長年の苦労の末にやっと完成した。
examples.transcription: ながねんのくろうのすえにやっとかんせいした。
examples.mean: It was finally completed after many years of struggle.

title: ... やっと => at last; finally (Realizing what is expected)
